entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to make a return. I bought a jersey a little while ago and I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order from about 85 days ago for the Pro-Line Cycling Jersey. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
It's simply the wrong size. I waited a bit too long to try it on, and it's just too tight across the chest. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size.

I understand completely. Let me just confirm our policy for that item. ... Okay, yes, it looks like that jersey falls under our 90-day return policy. You're still within the window, so I can definitely process that for you.

Oh, fantastic. That's a relief. Now, since I have to go through the process of packaging it up and sending it back, is there any way you could offer a small credit or a discount code for my trouble? I'm going to be ordering the replacement size right away.

I appreciate you asking. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on a standard size exchange, I can confirm that the exchange will be completely free of charge. We'll email you a prepaid shipping label, and we'll cover the cost of sending the new size out to you as soon as we receive the original.
Okay, so no shipping costs at all. That's fair. I can work with that. Let's proceed with the exchange, then.
Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for one size up. The prepaid return label is on its way to your email inbox right now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
